name: ArtiSys SEO
boundary: Portable SEO configuration, technical artifact generation, deterministic auditing, dashboard view-models and an optional Search Console read-only adapter. Product hosting and content stay in the consumer. Google OAuth credentials are reused from environment/rclone and are never hardcoded in the module.
limitations: Search Console network requests only occur when its explicit adapter or explicit OAuth bootstrap command is used.
The OAuth bootstrap saves a Search Console token separately from the rclone Drive token.
Long-lived token refresh integration with deployed consumers remains separate.
Analytics, tracking, hosting and product persistence remain outside this phase.
